summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError (direct Exception subclass) and parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier), which follows the seven-step procedure in the spec and only reads the graph. Added test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a module-scoped Turtle fixture and a parametrized test over valid and invalid shapes, including a check that the graph is unchanged after each call. Ran the new tests together with test/test_path.py using the prepared venv: 40 passed. No existing files were modified and nothing was committed. Ruff and mypy were not available in the venv, so linting and type checking were not run; the new files have no lines over 88 characters. Choices where the spec was silent: malformed or cyclic RDF lists raise SHACLPathError; non-Node inputs raise TypeError; when a modifier predicate has multiple values, one arbitrary value is used.
